provenance: Codex revisions after inspecting codex-pilot-v1 feedback. Hypothesis: the strongest reserve-space penalties are too aggressive; make departures from best-fit rare and preserve exact fits. This is exploratory model-guided iteration.

candidates.name: gentle_tiny_penalty
candidates.hypothesis: Penalize tiny nonzero gaps by only three capacity units, reducing the harmful diversion seen in v1.

candidates.name: gentle_subthird
candidates.hypothesis: A five-unit effective penalty may avoid unusable gaps without sacrificing much immediate fit.

candidates.name: gentle_subthird_inverse
candidates.hypothesis: Combine a modest subthird penalty with a smooth reward for very tight fits.

candidates.name: tight_or_roomy_conservative
candidates.hypothesis: Reduce preference for roomy gaps so only very large residual differences justify avoiding a tight fit.

candidates.name: tight_or_roomy_moderate
candidates.hypothesis: Intermediate compromise between best-fit and the small-family benefit observed in v1.

candidates.name: inverse_with_gap
candidates.hypothesis: A weak roomy preference plus reciprocal tightness avoids hard threshold discontinuities.
